simulation_form.name: arena16_q32_32_v1
simulation_form.fixed_point_format: Q32.32 signed 64-bit integer with explicit 128-bit intermediate products (arithmetic right shift >> 32, toward-zero unsigned-magnitude division, exact integer floor square root isqrt_u128)
simulation_form.execution_contract: SCXML macrostep + GameRule declaration-order traversal + deferred pickup deactivation/respawn at tick end
simulation_form.state_hash: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) over 732-byte little-endian canonical state vector

hypotheses.claim: Simulation projections of the 16-body Form under Q32.32 integer physics are bitwise identical across all 5 compilation/runtime targets for 100,000 ticks.
hypotheses.kill_criterion: Any SHA-256 state hash mismatch at any 1,000-tick checkpoint or at tick 100,000 on any target pair.

hypotheses.claim: Relaxing strict numeric discipline (compiler -ffast-math FMA contraction, cross-runtime hardware/library sin/cos transcendentals, or f32 precision) causes state hashes to diverge at an exact measurable tick t_div, and chaotic 16-body collisions amplify single-ULP perturbations into macroscopic position (>=1e-3 units) and discrete gameplay (score/FSM/quadrant) desynchronization.
controls: cpp_f64_strict_trig vs js_f64_math_sin_trig (strict f64 with native libm sin/cos vs V8 Math.sin/Math.cos)
observables: t_div_ieee_bits: first tick where canonical IEEE-754 state hash diverges
t_div_macro_1e3: first tick where quantized 1e-3 arena-unit position hash diverges
t_div_gameplay: first tick where discrete gameplay state (scores, cooldown FSM states, active pickups, arena quadrants) diverges
